notes.title: TMNT: Empire City - Dev Diary #2
notes.content: [p]The rooftops of New York are such iconic environments for the Turtles, so using them for navigation became a top priority for us. When designing our movement system for Empire City, our north star was to help players feel like a Ninja Turtle who grew up in New York, leaping from building to building with a sense of style and speed. We want Empire City players to feel that, over time, they have a command over every nook and cranny of the city just like Leo, Donnie, Raph, or Mikey would. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rOJ7vMJxHGY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Check out Dev Diary #2 in the video above and read more here 👉🔗 [url="https://www.cortopia.com/tmnt-empire-city-dev-diary-2/"]https://www.cortopia.com/tmnt-empire-city-dev-diary-2/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In the lead-up to the launch of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City in 2026, we will provide you with insights into the game's design and production through a series of developer diaries. [/p][p]Keep an eye out for Dev Diary #3 in September![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City is a TMNT parkour-action game for VR
notes.content: We've had a TMNT sidescrolling beat-em-up, a TMNT turn-based tactics RPG, and a TMNT Hades clone with co-op. They're even in Call of Duty, if you can afford to fork out like $90. It's a good time to be into the Ninja Turtles, whether or not you believe 2025 is the year of the ninja... Read more.

notes.title: IGN Exclusively Reveals first ever TMNT VR Game
notes.content:
Built from the ground up for virtual reality, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City will let players suit up as Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello or Michelangelo in an action-driven adventure that’s equal parts hard-hitting combat and an exploration of the bonds of brotherhood. Find out more in this exclusive reveal from IGN: 

https://www.ign.com/articles/teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-empire-city-announced-for-meta-quest-and-steam-vr
